verdict.line: You lose if you walk up into Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot before level 3; you win if you land E (Apprehend) on him and chain Q, W, and R before he kites off with Move Quick.

brief.thesis: Teemo wins at range for free — Blinding Dart (8s cooldown, 680 range) and the on-hit Toxic Shot poison chip Darius while Move Quick lets him kite any walk-up attempt. Darius's entire win condition is landing E (Apprehend, 535 range, 26s cooldown at rank 1) to drag Teemo into stick range; once that connects, Hemorrhage stacks and the true-damage R (Noxian Guillotine) end the fight instantly. The 1997-game sample backs this read: the lane itself is dead even and the only real edge Darius holds is the solo-kill column.

theirWindow.what: He can blind you on approach, which cancels your auto-attack damage and negates W (Crippling Strike) for its duration — don't walk up to trade while this is up, just absorb the poke.

yourWindow.what: Pull him in with E first, then Q, auto with W active, and finish with R once Hemorrhage is stacked — never auto first, since that's what he kites away from.

start.why: 45.8% win rate and the clear pick (73.1%) because the passive block and sustain absorb Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot chip while you look for a window to close.

boots.why: 71.4% pick rate for a reason — the magic resist directly undercuts Toxic Shot's damage-over-time and Noxious Trap's poison cloud.

core.why: the active haste is your answer to Move Quick — it's the only way to run Teemo down once he starts kiting.
stacking magic resist and move speed directly counters his poison poke and lets you close distance faster over time.
extra move speed to stick post-engage plus armor for when he swaps to a kited siege with mushrooms.

runes.keystoneWhy: stacks on every hit landed through his poke, and the healing at max stacks keeps you alive through the chip damage you take just closing distance.

summoners.why: this pairing runs a 47.4% win rate here — Ignite seals the kill the instant E (Apprehend) lands and R executes, matching the matchup's measured solo-kill advantage for Darius; Flash extends your engage range when he's one step outside E.

playing.title: Don't trade before level 3
playing.detail: You have no gap-closer until E unlocks, so absorb Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot chip rather than walking up into his 680-range poke.

playing.title: Punish when his Q is down
playing.detail: Blinding Dart is only an 8s cooldown but it's a commitment — once he burns it on minions or wastes it baiting, step up and trade freely for that window.

playing.title: Open every fight with E
playing.detail: Apprehend's 535-range hook is your only counter to Move Quick kiting; pull first, then Q, then auto under W, never auto-attack first.

playing.title: Save R for the finish, not the opener
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine's true damage scales off Hemorrhage stacks, so land it after Q and autos have already stacked bleed, ideally at the 5-stack enrage.

playing.title: Prioritize Mercury's Treads on time
playing.detail: The magic resist is a direct answer to his sustained Toxic Shot DPS and Noxious Trap zoning — don't delay boots here.

playing.title: Scout brush before dashing in with E
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has only a 1s cooldown, so he can carpet chokepoints; check for mushrooms before committing your pull so you don't eat a slow mid-engage.

playing.title: Hunt the all-in before level 6
playing.detail: The data gives you the solo-kill edge in this matchup, so look to force a fight the moment E is up and he's overextended for cs, instead of passively scaling.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and summoner splits are pulled from measured Darius vs Teemo games on the current patch (16.19.1); the lane-timing and mechanical reasoning connecting them is my own read.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being punished by Teemo before reaching level 3 by keeping your distance from him. Close in when Teemo steps in your range to try to kill him or to at least get a Summoner’s Spell.
